steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Though I considered the possibility that Leontuzzo was trying to pull a fast one on me behind my back, my suspicions were confirmed the moment I saw you.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You're the real deal, a flesh-and-blood Texas.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Allow me to introduce myself. I am Wallach of Famiglia Rossati.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You're Columbian?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Of course. Most associates of Famiglia Rossati are.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: So, how did you enjoy prison life here?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: There was nothing special about it.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Strange. Logically, you never should've spent so long in jail in the first place. Just what was Bellone thinking?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Is there something unusual about obeying the law?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: The law? What do the courts here in Siracusa have to do with the so-called law?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Look at it this way. In most Siracusan cities, standing trial and going to jail is a common coming-of-age ritual for a young mafioso.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: After that, his famiglia associates go pick him up, like a warrior returning home triumphant.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Everything on the surface here is meaningless to those who live by the underworld's ways.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: What's your point?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You grew up in Columbia. Do I need to spell it out for you?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: 'A complete joke.' There's no other way to say it.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: But that's why we were able to establish ourselves here so easily.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Do you enjoy talking politics?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You obviously don't.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: To be honest with you, I'm not a fan either.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: I'll get to the point then. Why aren't you dead.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: None of your business.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Fine. Let me ask you a different question then. Why did you come back?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Didn't Leontuzzo tell you already? I owe the Bellones a favor.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: So, let me get this straight. You knew the Bellones wanted to bring you back to deal with us Rossatis, but you still went along with it.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I didn't know that until I got here, but... you could say that.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Your bluntness makes me wonder if there's something wrong with me, last of the Texases.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Are you going to tell me you forgot the Texas name used to rule all of Columbia's famiglie, large and small?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: That your grandfather, Salvadore, was the lodestar for every associate of every famiglia in Columbia?!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: What the Texases left behind... has nothing to do with me.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Nothing to do with you?!
Wallach smashes his fist into the coffee table next to him, and fresh blood begins to seep from his fingers.
He does not seem to realize it.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You are Cellinia Texas! The granddaughter of Salvadore!

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: As long as you live, those things have everything to do with you!

spans.text: As long as you live, those things have

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: The mere mention of your name at a Rossati table forces us to change the way we do things!

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Texas was our pride!

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Do you know how much effort Giovanna put in to reunite the remaining Columbian famiglie so that Salvadore's blood and sweat would not go to waste?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Do you have any idea what it was like to finally give in to Signora Sicilia, traveling thousands of miles to go from Columbia to Siracusa?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: In order to survive, we even gave up the technology to build a nomadic city, basically letting Siracusa construct a new one for free—

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: That was all because of the fall of Texas. It left us no choice but to accept this reality.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: And now you, the last Texas, deign to set foot here like you own the damned place.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Claiming that you have nothing to do with all this, that you're just here to pay off a debt.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You even go so far as to stand against us!

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You owe the Bellones?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: That you're even alive means you owe a much bigger debt to the Columbian famiglie!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I might owe Giovanna an explanation, but I don't owe a thing to the Columbians.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: After I settle my accounts with the Bellones, I'm leaving Siracusa.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You think we'll take your word for it?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Your very existence shakes the foundations of Famiglia Rossati.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Where's Giovanna?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'm asking, why are you here? Instead of Giovanna?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: I speak for her.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: She wouldn't, for example, grovel at Signora Sicilia's feet.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Same as she wouldn't send a representative to meet me.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You think you know her so well?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Judging from your expression, looks like I'm right.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Hah... Isn't that unlucky.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Turns out I'm the one who doesn't know enough about the legendary Texas.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: I always thought I was a pretty good actor.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You're not bad.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But, you speak eloquently and at great lengths about Siracusa, as if you've seen through the country for what it is. It feels... very familiar to me.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I wouldn't keep doing that, if I were you.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Why not?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Because it proves... you don't understand this place well enough.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But, you are right about one thing. Now that I'm back, I should go have a chat with Giovanna.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You won't be seeing her.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Sorry about this, last of the Texases.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You're too much like a Siracusan. No, you are a Siracusan, through and through.

spans.text: You're too much like a Siracusan. No, you

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: So I cannot let you see the Donna.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You'll shake her. And you'll shake others too. You'll bring ruin to a great many things.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: So, please turn back.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Go close the deal you have with the Bellones, and then crawl back wherever you came from.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You're free to do what you want from here.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: But, I'll ask you to bear one thing in mind.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Famiglia Rossati does not welcome you.
Texas stands up and walks to the door.
Unconsciously, the would-be assassins part and make way for her.
She looks around, reading anger, bewilderment, disgust, confusion, and other emotions in the eyes of the Columbians.
That is what her surname brings to the table.
Texas.
She lets out a sigh and exits the room.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: What an unexpected guest.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I want to see Bernardo.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: I've already warned you several times before not to call the Don by his first name, Signorina Lavinia.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: You know where he is, don't you?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Give me one reason why I should tell you.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: If standing here listening to you mock me from your position as the big winner is enough to get you to tell me, I'll gladly play along.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: The big winner, huh...?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Whatever.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: It's not like you knowing will do any harm. The Don already left for the Saluzzo mansion.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You won't be able to see him.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: If you want to stir up trouble in his household, that's on you.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: But if the Don has decided to open discussions with the Saluzzos, I suggest you don't stick your head where it doesn't belong.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Don't need to tell me twice.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: One more thing, Signorina Lavinia.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: I don't care what you think about me.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: But, I hope you do remember this.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Leon is a made man in this famiglia, and he was the first to deviate from our path.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: We are all one famiglia, and a famiglia ought to stick together.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Your path?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: That's a nice euphemism for craven ambition.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Heh.
A droplet of rain strikes the ridge of her eye socket and rolls down like a teardrop.
Never in her life has Lavinia experienced rain so frigid and biting in Siracusa.
But she promptly wipes away the streaks.
It's too soon for that.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Who is it?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I'm looking for Penguin Logistics.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: That's me.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Do you have time right now?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I have a moment.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: What services does your business offer?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: We deliver letters, messages, goods, and... people.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Rain or shine.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Perfect. I have a job for you.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh, Sora, you went to Caterina's place after all?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: There are tons of resources here, and Miss Caterina even left her notes in a lot of these scripts.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: She's really passionate about her job, huh?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Stop sighin', won'tcha?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Everybody knows yer actin' thingy ain't just another way of chasin' Texas. Leastwise, you don't want it to be.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Right. But, finding her is still our top priority...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: After all, Lappland is back in Siracusa, and she's been doing some pretty crazy stuff.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: If you think about, it makes perfect sense.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: It always feels like she's there, wherever Texas shows up.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Do you think she's doing it to help Texas?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Lookin' at the scoreboard, Texas sure as sunshine got her name cleared. But ain't that kinda strange, whichever way ya look at it?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Yes. I'm sure she has her own goals.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Gaaah, I don't have what it takes to deal with that woman.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Anyways, she ain't no friend of Texas, don't take a genius to know that much. But her attitude ain't much like an enemy, neither.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: End of the day, I just can't figure out for the life of me what it is she wants outta Texas.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: But, the mille-feuille she gave me earlier was really good.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Don't wanna hear nothin' outta that hungry mouth of yours.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: It's kind of like how I used to look at Mostima. I couldn't figure her out, but after I gradually stopped thinking about her, she actually started to make sense to me.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I feel like it's the same with Lappland.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: For people like her, there's no point trying to guess at what they're thinking. It's better to just accept what they say at face value.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Only if every word they say is true can you start to figure if they're ultimately trying to weave truths into a lie.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Time for me to get some chow. Exusiai, you watch over things, okay?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You got it~

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Sora, are you practicing your lines again?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Oh, hi there, Miss Caterina.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: We're about to start our performance of Act II of 'La Morte di Texas,' so I have to step it up.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Oh, I completely forgot. Time sure has a way of sneaking up on you.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Exusiai, would you like some pizza?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Sure would!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: By the way, Miss Caterina, since you're the playwright, you'll be coming to watch the show, right?

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: I actually wanted to tell you that I'm going away for a while.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: For how long?

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Well... It shouldn't be too long, if everything goes as planned.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Don't worry, it's nothing major. Something happened back home, and as the eldest daughter, I have to go back and get everything under control.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Being a big sister is hard work, isn't it?

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Haha. It's not so bad.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Unfortunately, I'm still not sure what to do for the climax of Act III.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: *sigh*... Maybe I can find some inspiration back home this time.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Come on, don't look at me like that. We just won't be seeing each other for a bit. I should still be able to find the time to come watch Act II.

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Who knows, maybe I'll surprise you backstage and invite you out.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: After all, I rarely get to make new friends, and I wouldn't want to miss the performance of a script I wrote myself.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Right. That settles it then. If you're coming by, you have to let me know!

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: Of course!

steps.name: Caterina
steps.text: I'm off then. Goodbye.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Bye bye~

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: See you later~

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Donna, you didn't bring any luggage?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: After we're done here, I have to head back to finish my script. What's there for me to bring?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: How have the Saluzzos and Bellones been reacting?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: The Saluzzos invited Leontuzzo to a banquet, and the old wolf Bernardo agreed to it.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: That banquet may end up very interesting, and everyone has eyes on it now.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Should we respond in any way?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Wallach, help me make some travel plans.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: I'm going to go watch the opening performance of 'La Morte di Texas' Act II.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Is the script you wrote that important to you?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Of course. It is the product of my painstaking labor.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Also, didn't you just ask how we were going to respond?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: That is my response, seeing how Bernardo Bellone is about to step away from his own theater.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Naturally, I, Giovanna Rossati, ought to return.
